summary.text: Robert Vroman is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democratic incumbent Del Taylor is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Robert Vroman advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for District 84.

Ballotpedia lists earlier campaigns including the Republican primary for Missouri's 1st Congressional District in 2018, the St. Louis City Treasurer general election in 2020, and the St. Louis Collector of Revenue general election in 2022.
In 2024 he was the Republican candidate for Missouri State Senate District 5, losing to incumbent Steve Roberts.
